assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one full-body character-selection standing illustration for a monochrome 2D arena game.
Input image 1 is ONLY a style and ornament reference: the game's existing engraved sword. Create a NEW warrior character that belongs to exactly this visual world, not an illustration of the sword.
Subject: one adult male fantasy warrior, athletic build, short slightly tousled dark hair, clean-shaven angular face, calm resolute expression, no helmet. White/silver plate armor outlined in black, layered broad shoulder guards, a single dark diamond inset centered on the breastplate, dark fitted undersuit and dark waist sash, armored gauntlets and boots. A restrained short split cloak behind the shoulders. Repeat the reference sword's angular diamond metal detailing and fine engraved hatching sparingly on the armor.
Style: polished hand-drawn black ink fantasy game illustration, strong crisp contour, white metal planes, subtle gray crosshatching, same etched steel material and line weight vocabulary as the reference sword. Strictly grayscale / black and white, not a photograph or 3D render.
Composition: portrait 2:3 canvas, complete body from hair to soles, centered with modest transparent margins, confident neutral standing pose, slight three-quarter torso turn but head looking toward viewer. Both hands empty and relaxed near the hips. Compact silhouette, readable anatomy, no oversized cape.
Background: truly transparent alpha PNG, all background pixels transparent, no scenery, no ground plane, no cast shadow.
Constraints: exactly one person, no weapon or shield or sheath, no text, no labels, no frame, no UI, no colored accents, no decorative background. Preserve clear light face and armor surfaces against transparency. This will be the identity reference for a square avatar and a small battle sprite.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: square character avatar for a monochrome fantasy game, one single PNG image.
Input image 1 is the EXACT character identity and armor reference. Create a new tight head-and-shoulders avatar of THIS SAME adult male warrior, preserving his face, short swept tousled black hair, clean-shaven angular jaw, resolute expression, raised white armor collar, layered shoulder guards and angular dark diamond metal insets. Same grayscale engraved ink illustration as the source, crisp black contours, white/silver steel and restrained fine hatch shading.
Composition: 1:1 square canvas, head centered, face clearly legible when displayed at 42 pixels. Hair almost reaches top with a safe margin, shoulder armor fills the lower width, lower chest cut by canvas edge, face takes prominent central area. Front-facing with the same subtle three-quarter turn as the reference. It must look like the same character, not a different man.
Background truly transparent alpha PNG. No surrounding aura, ground, border, frame, letters, words, UI, extra characters, weapon, helmet, color, or photorealism. Keep the top of the hair fully inside the image. Prioritize strong readable facial features.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single small battle-unit sprite for a browser 2D arena. One image, not a spritesheet.
Input image 1 is the exact warrior identity, hair, costume and armor reference. Adapt THIS SAME character into a compact 3-head-tall game figure for clear recognition at only 36–64 pixels. Same short tousled black hair, angular clean-shaven adult face, white/silver layered shoulder guards, black undersuit, large central dark diamond on breastplate, black waist sash, white engraved gauntlets and boots, short split dark cloak.
Style: black and white engraved-ink fantasy art matching the reference; bold crisp silhouette and outer outlines, clean broad white armor shapes, far fewer thin hatching details for small-size readability. Adult heroic miniature proportions, not a baby or plush toy. Preserve the reference's face and armor identity in simplified form.
Composition: 1:1 square transparent PNG, entire standing body visible including hair, hands and both boots, compact wide balanced ready stance, slightly bent knees, legs apart, head and chest facing the viewer with subtle three-quarter turn. Arms slightly away from torso and empty hands loosely clenched, no extended attack pose. Figure occupies about 90% of canvas height and 70–80% width, centered. Full silhouette must fit safely inside canvas.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, all outside pixels fully clear, no glow, no aura, no drop shadow or floor. No weapon, no shield, no sheath: the sword is animated independently in game. No text, labels, frame, UI, colors, second figure, photographic background, or spritesheet.
